**Issue #4171 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4171: Patch: a test holds the AI's per-attack combat math to the game's combat forecast on boards from seeded games, and a blow a First Strike defender stops is worth nothing to the AI
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

To plan quickly, the computer opponent works out fights with its own arithmetic instead of asking the game. The game has its own forecast of each fight, the one players are shown. Every time the two have disagreed, someone found it by reading code and fixed it by hand, about six times in the last month.

This adds a test that plays a few dozen quick random games. Whenever an attack could be made, it checks that the AI's arithmetic and the game's forecast agree about every possible attack: the damage each side deals, who dies, and whether a shield pops.

It also fixes the first disagreement already found. When a First Strike defender such as Radiant Pointmaster kills the attacker before it can strike, the AI's model of you still credits that attack with chip damage and a popped Divine Shield. So it expects you to make attacks that gain you nothing. The next disagreement a new card brings in will fail a test instead of waiting for someone to spot it.

## Why

- **The AI restates the forecast.** Its per-attack reads re-derive what the engine's `combat_forecast` and `forecast_attack` compute through `project_hit` (`crates/engine/src/query.rs:1022`, `:1059-1121`). The reads are `fight` (`crates/ai/src/reply.rs:86-117`), and `blow` and `kills_and_survives` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs:170-378`). Each one redoes Divine Shield, Armor and Pierce, the caps, conversion, damage pools, Poisonous and exile, First Strike order, and Ranged.
- **Each new mechanic has reached the two separately**, and they were reconciled by hand: #4064 (#4102, pools and the Burn and Toxic Rounds), #4023 (#4052, Anime Armor's cap), #4065 (#4101, The Banisher's exile, which the forecast got separately in #4151), #3937 (#4031) and #3909 (#3930).
- **The tests that hold them together compare too little.** They are `r2179005_the_trade_reads_agree_with_the_combat_forecast` (`candidates.rs:1405`, 13×13 hand-built bodies) and `r4064000_r4064001_…` (`candidates.rs:1774`, 9×9 bodies under 4 pool settings). Both compare only the kill and the death. Their bodies have no Trample, Cleave, lane multiplier or combat bonus, and neither test checks what each side deals or whether a shield pops.
- **That is how this mismatch got past them.** When a First Strike defender destroys the attacker first, `fight` sets `lands` false but leaves `out` as if the blow had landed (`reply.rs:91, 106`). `trade_value` then still adds `AI_REPLY.chip_per_damage` per point and `AI_EVAL.keyword.divine_shield` for the pop (`reply.rs:220-227`). The Lifesteal and conversion terms just below are gated on `lands`; these two are not. The forecast deals 0 and pops nothing in that case (`query.rs:1087-1091, 1118`).
- **A concrete case.** With Radiant Pointmaster (Core #20: 12/2, Rush, First Strike, Divine Shield) on the AI's field, the opponent model reads a small attacker's suicide into it as worth a shield the attacker never touches.
- **Nothing holds the AI to the forecast on real boards.** #4151 holds the forecast to the real combat for every attack played, but the AI's reads are checked only on the hand-built bodies above.

## Proposal

1. In `trade_value`, a blow that does not land (`!lands`) earns no chip and no shield pop, as the forecast reads it.
2. Add a test in the crate's unit tests, beside the two agreement tests, since `fight` is `pub(crate)`:
   - It plays `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_GAMES` seeded games of SPEC §10.7's random policy through `play_match`, with `MatchHooks.after_action` collecting each state. Both decks are dealt by `build_ai_deck` from every set.
   - On every state where a seat may attack (its Main phase, no prompt open), it takes each Unit-target entry of `combat_forecast(state, seat)`. It compares `fight` and `kills_and_survives`, under `AI_EVAL`, field by field: what the attacker deals (capped by Trample, and nothing when the blow does not land), what it takes, kills, survives, pops.
   - A mismatch fails the test, naming the seed, the action index, both cards (id and face) and each read's values.
3. The test asserts a floor on the attacks it judged and on the distinct Unit cards it met, so it cannot pass by checking nothing. It runs in the per-PR `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`.
4. Each further mismatch the test finds is fixed in the AI's read in the same PR. One that needs a rules decision too big for that PR stays a named exception in the test, with its reason, and is listed in the PR.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (`fight`, `trade_value`)
- `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` (`blow`, `kills_and_survives`, and the test module the agreement tests live in)
- Read only: `crates/ai/src/match_.rs` (`play_match`, `MatchHooks`) and `crates/engine/src/query.rs` (`combat_forecast`)
- `crates/ai/README.md` (the reply paragraph), SPEC §9.9 (The opponent's reply), a new ruling note and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A unit test: an attacker without First Strike attacks a First Strike, Divine Shield defender that destroys it first, and `trade_value` gives it no chip and no shield pop. This test fails on `main`.
- [ ] The agreement test compares all five fields on every Unit-target forecast entry of every state it collects.
- [ ] With the fix reverted, the agreement test fails: its seeds include a First Strike defender destroying an attacker first.
- [ ] It asserts its floors (attacks judged, distinct Unit cards met) and reports both counts when it fails.
- [ ] It runs per PR, not under `#[ignore]`, in a few seconds, and the PR states how long it takes.
- [ ] Any exception is named in the test with its reason and listed in the PR.
- [ ] These all pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke).

## Size and risks

Medium: one small fix, a test of about 100 to 150 lines, the ruling and the docs.

The test may find more mismatches than the one above. Each should be a small fix like the six before it, but several at once make the PR larger.

Random-policy boards rarely show Radiant faces or rare keywords. The floors keep the test honest about how much it checks, but they do not promise every card, so the hand-built bodies stay.

The fix slightly changes which attacks the AI's model of the opponent expects when a First Strike defender stands, so AI decisions there can change. It is a correctness fix, not a measured strength gain.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44244351839)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Ship a unit test proving a stopped blow earns nothing, the one-line `trade_value` fix behind it, and a seeded-games agreement test holding the AI's per-attack reads (`fight`, `kills_and_survives`, `trade_value`) to the engine's `combat_forecast` on all five fields (dealt, taken, kills, survives, pops), plus ruling R4171000 and doc updates. Done means every acceptance criterion of #4171 holds and the named checks pass.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` | change | `trade_value`: gate chip and shield-pop on `lands`; tests module: new `r4171000_…` unit test |
| `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` | change | tests module only: imports plus new `r4171000_…` seeded-games agreement test; plus a `kills_and_survives` defender-first fix only if the new test finds that mismatch |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | new named constants `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_GAMES`, `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_MIN_ATTACKS`, `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_MIN_CARDS`, `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_MIN_STOPPED` (rule 9) |
| `spec/rulings/R4171000.md` | new | ruling note (first free number in #4171's block; verify with `ls spec/rulings/R4171*`) |
| `spec/pending/4171.md` | new | the §11 paragraph for R4171000 |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | one sentence in the reply paragraph (~L90-100): stopped blows earn nothing |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | one sentence in §9.9 where attacks are priced, citing `[[R4171000]]` |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (the daily fold owns them); any engine, cards, web, e2e or server code. Governing spec: §4.3 step 1 (First Strike order, stopped blows), §4.4 steps 1-5 (hit pipeline, Trample cap), §9.9 (opponent's reply), §10.7 (random policy). Read-only: `crates/ai/src/match_.rs`, `crates/engine/src/query.rs`, `crates/ai/src/deck.rs`, `crates/ai/src/baselines.rs`.

## Steps

1. Re-read the touched spec (§4.3 step 1, §4.4 steps 1-5, §9.9) and `spec/README.md` "Adding a ruling". Re-read `fight` and `trade_value` (`reply.rs:86-269`), `exchange`/`blow`/`kills_and_survives` and the two agreement tests (`candidates.rs:1405`, `:1774`), and `forecast_attack` (`query.rs:1059-1121`).
2. Confirm `R4171000` is free (`ls spec/rulings/R4171*` shows nothing). Write `spec/rulings/R4171000.md`: title "A blow a First Strike defender stops deals nothing and pops nothing"; `cards` naming §4.3 and Core #20; body: a First Strike defender that destroys (or exiles) the attacker first leaves no blow to land, so the blow deals 0 and pops no Divine Shield, and the AI's static read prices no chip and no pop for it — Hearthstone semantics, matching `combat_forecast`'s `falls`; `proven_in` listing `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` and `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`. Write `spec/pending/4171.md` with the one `**[[R4171000]] … (issue #4171, <date>)**: …` paragraph.
3. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, after `AI_REPLY`, add the four constants: `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_GAMES: usize = 24`, `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_MIN_ATTACKS: i32`, `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_MIN_CARDS: i32`, `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_MIN_STOPPED: i32 = 1`. Set the two middle floors after step 6 measures (at or below observed counts with margin; report both numbers when the test fails, per step 6).
4. Fix `trade_value` (`reply.rs:220-227`): compute the non-kill value as `0.0` when `!lands`, else the current chip term; and add the shield pop only under `lands`:
   `let mut value = if !lands { 0.0 } else if kills { removed(&a, target) } else { AI_REPLY.chip_per_damage * f64::from(out.dealt.min(t.view.health)) };`
   `if lands && out.pops_shield { value += AI_EVAL.keyword.divine_shield; }`
   Nothing else changes (`kills` is already false when `!lands`; cleave, conversion, Lifesteal are already `lands`-gated).
5. In `reply.rs` tests module (reuse `POINTMASTER`, `OOMEN` consts), add `fn r4171000_a_stopped_blow_earns_no_chip_and_no_shield_pop`: (a) p1 OOMEN (1/2, no First Strike) vs p2 Radiant Pointmaster (`{"def": "core-020", "radiant": true}`, 12/2 First Strike Divine Shield): assert `fight(...).lands` is false, `trade.kills` false, and `trade.value` equals `-kill_worth(state, oomen, &AI_EVAL, Prices::NONE)` within 1e-9 (no pop term); (b) p1 OOMEN vs p2 base Pointmaster (First Strike, no shield, destroys OOMEN first): assert `!lands` and `trade.value` equals `-kill_worth(...)` within 1e-9 (no chip term). Run it, then temporarily revert step 4 and confirm it fails (buggy value is higher by the pop weight in (a) and by `chip_per_damage * dealt` in (b)), then re-apply.
6. In `candidates.rs` tests module, add `fn r4171000_the_trade_reads_agree_with_the_combat_forecast_on_seeded_games`: for `n` in `0..FORECAST_AGREEMENT_GAMES`, seed `format!("forecast-agreement:{n}")`, deal both decks with `build_ai_deck(&mut Rng::new(&format!("{seed}:deck:{}", seat.as_str())), 0), DECK_SIZE, &AiDeckOptions { banned: Some(vec![]), gated_sets: Some(vec![]), ..Default::default() })`, play `play_match(&MatchConfig { seed, decks, controllers: PerPlayer { p1: SeatController::Random, p2: SeatController::Random }, max_actions: None, setup: MatchSetup::default() }, &mut hooks)` with `MatchHooks.after_action` pushing `before.clone()` on the first call and every `after.clone()` into a `Vec<GameState>`. For each collected state, for each seat with `state.pending.is_none() && state.active == seat && state.phase == Phase::Main`, for each `combat_forecast(state, seat)` entry whose target is not a hero: look up attacker/target via `find_instance`, compute `f = fight(state, attacker, target)`, and assert all of: dealt equals `if !f.lands { 0 } else if attacker has Trample { f.out.dealt.min(f.t.view.health.max(0)) } else { f.out.dealt }` vs `entry.dealt`; taken equals `if a.first_strike && !t.first_strike && f.kills { 0 } else { f.back.dealt }` vs `entry.taken` (forecast `:1102` zeroes the strike back a First Strike attacker pre-empts; `fight.back` is raw); `f.kills == entry.kills`; `!f.dies == entry.survives`; `(f.lands && f.out.pops_shield) == entry.pops`; `kills_and_survives(state, attacker, target) == (entry.kills && entry.survives)`; and, when `!f.lands && f.t.converts.is_none()`, `trade_value(state, attacker, &entry.target_id, Prices::NONE).value` equals the trample face term (`subsystems::projected_damage` + `reply_face_value`, 0 without Trample) minus (`unit_worth` of the attacker if `f.t.exiles` else `kill_worth` of it) within 1e-9 — this is the tripwire that fails with step 4 reverted, since the forecast has no value field of its own. Count judged attacks, distinct `def_id`s met (in an `IndexSet`, never `HashSet`: purity lint), and stopped (`!lands`) blows; assert each meets its floor. Every failure message names the seed, the collected-state index, attacker/target ids and `def_id`s, and both sides' values, plus the three counts. Needed test-module imports: `crate::deck::{AiDeckOptions, build_ai_deck}`, `crate::match_::{MatchConfig, MatchHooks, MatchSetup, SeatController, play_match}`, `crate::reply::{fight, reply_face_value}`, `jackioh_engine::{PerPlayer, Phase, Rng}`, `jackioh_engine::config::DECK_SIZE`, the new constants, and `has_keyword`/`KeywordKind`/`AttackTarget`/`subsystems` (already in scope via `super::*`).
7. Run the agreement test. Fix each further mismatch inside the AI's read (small, like the six before); the likely one is `kills_and_survives` missing the defender-first case — if found, return false there when the defender strikes first and its strike destroys or exiles the attacker, mirroring `falls`. A mismatch needing a rules decision too big for the PR becomes a named exception in the test with its reason, listed in the PR description. Then revert step 4 temporarily and confirm the agreement test fails on a stopped blow; re-apply.
8. Add the one sentence to `crates/ai/README.md`'s reply paragraph and to §9.9, each citing the ruling. Measure the agreement test's wall time (`cargo test -p jackioh-ai r4171000 -- --nocapture` twice, note seconds) for the PR description.
9. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. Record every decision the task left open with the rejected alternative.

## Tests

- `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`, `r4171000_a_stopped_blow_earns_no_chip_and_no_shield_pop`: stopped blow into Radiant (Divine Shield) and base Pointmaster earns exactly `-kill_worth`, no chip, no pop. Fails on main.
- `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, `r4171000_the_trade_reads_agree_with_the_combat_forecast_on_seeded_games`: five-field agreement plus `trade_value` tripwire on every Unit-target forecast entry of every collected Main-phase state across `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_GAMES` random-policy games; floors on attacks, distinct cards, stopped blows. Fails with the fix reverted.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai r4171000`, then `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. (Full workspace suites, fuzz and gate are CI's.)

## Done when

- [ ] Stopped-blow unit test exists, fails on main, passes with the fix.
- [ ] Agreement test compares all five fields plus the `trade_value` tripwire on every Unit-target entry of every collected state, and fails with the fix reverted.
- [ ] Floors asserted and reported with counts; test un-`ignore`d, runs per PR in seconds (time stated in the PR).
- [ ] Any exception named in-test with reason and listed in the PR (or none).
- [ ] R4171000 note + `spec/pending/4171.md` paragraph; README and §9.9 sentences; the five checks above green.

## Risks

- Seeded random boards may under-show Radiant faces or rare keywords: floors keep the test honest, the stopped-blow floor forces the First Strike case, hand-built body tests stay.
- `kills_and_survives` may disagree on seeded boards (defender-first, exile, conversion edges): fix in the AI read in-PR, or named exception.
- The fix shifts reply/move-order values where a First Strike defender stands: a correctness fix, expect small AI decision changes there, no strength claim.
- Runtime: dozens of full random games must stay seconds per PR; lower `FORECAST_AGREEMENT_GAMES` before touching floors if slow. Determinism is safe (fixed seeds, engine `Rng`, no clock/I/O); hidden information is untouched (true states in unit tests, as existing tests do).

## Open questions

None.
```
